subject: your new whole foods shelf
body:
Hi Maria,

Congrats on landing the Whole Foods Northeast region last month. That usually means a second problem shows up about six weeks later: the store count jumps, and nobody is sure which doors are actually reordering.

At a chocolate brand in New York, we had the same blind spot. Once we tracked reorders by store instead of by distributor, we found the stores that had gone quiet and got most of them back. The fix was a weekly view your team could read without me.

Is reorder tracking something your ops team owns today, or does it sit with sales?

Avinash

subject: Quick question about your ops
body:
Hi there,

I hope this email finds you well. I'm writing about the operations role on your team.

I founded a software company in India.

At my current job, supplier on-time delivery went from 60% to 95%, errors dropped 40%, and payments came 15 days faster.

I built that loop.

Would a short call make sense?

Whenever suits you.

subject: kind grain on faire
body:
Hi Leo,

Saw Kind Grain's granola go from two SKUs to five on Faire this summer. More SKUs is good news for buyers and a headache for whoever keeps units and cases straight between Faire and Shopify.

We hit that exact mismatch last year: an order for ten bars synced as ten cases. The fix was mapping every variant once and flagging any order where the two platforms disagree, before it ships.

If that sounds familiar, what does your team check today before a wholesale order goes out?

Avinash

subject: salt snacks retail velocity
body:
Hi Sam,

Your post about slow sell-through at the new Target doors stuck with me. Most brands read that as a demand problem, and sometimes it is. Just as often the product is sitting in the back room, or the tag is missing from the shelf.

One way to tell the two apart is to compare units per store per week across doors that opened in the same month. When a handful lag far behind, the problem is usually execution, not the product.

Would a door-by-door view like that be useful for your next buyer review?

Avinash
